y-m-65-05.material:
Akwai yanayi uku.
(가) Tsarin da rabon lahani yake tsayayye 2% kowane lokaci; adadin kayayyakin lahani cikin abubuwa 20 da aka ƙera ba tare da shafar juna ba.
(나) Adadin ƙwallaye baƙi da suka fito idan aka zana ƙwallaye 4 ba tare da mayarwa ba daga jaka mai ƙwallaye fari 3 da baƙi 7.

(라) Adadin kan kuɗi idan aka jefa kuɗi sau 12.
Muna son tantance ko adadin nasarori a kowane yanayi yana bin rarrabuwar binomial.

y-m-65-11.topic: Yiwuwar sharadi da tushen bayani: yadda aka buɗe ƙofa
y-m-65-11.goal: Tantance cewa ko da yanayin ya yi iri ɗaya ne (an buɗe ƙofa ɗaya aka ga akuya), yiwuwar cin nasara idan aka sauya zaɓi tana canzawa idan bayanin yadda aka buɗe ƙofar ya bambanta, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
y-m-65-11.material: Akwai ƙofofi 3. Bayan wata ƙofa mota ce, bayan sauran biyun kuma awaki ne; yiwuwar motar tana bayan kowace ƙofa iri ɗaya ce. Mai takara ya zaɓi ƙofa ta 1, sai mai gabatarwa ya buɗe ƙofa ta 3 aka ga akuya. Mai takara zai iya sauya zaɓinsa zuwa ƙofa ta 2.
y-m-65-11.thinking.2: Kwatanta samfura daban-daban na yanayi ɗaya
y-m-65-11.prereq.1: Ma'anar yiwuwar sharadi (sararin samfurin yana ƙuntatawa)
y-m-65-11.prereq.2: Sharadi: mota tana bayan ɗaya daga ƙofofi 3 da yiwuwar su iri ɗaya, awaki kuma suna bayan sauran ƙofofin. Mai fafatawa ya zaɓi ƙofa 1.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.prompt: Yanke mataki-mataki yadda yiwuwar samun motar ke sauyawa idan ka sauya zaɓi.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, rubuta yiwuwar yanayin da aka raba bisa 'idan mota tana bayan ƙofa 1, ƙofa 2, ko ƙofa 3'.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta yanayin da sabon bayani ya cire ko yadda yiwuwarsu ta sauya.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.info: Ba a san yadda mai gabatarwa ya zaɓi ƙofa 3 ba. Abin da kawai aka sani shi ne akwai akuya a bayan ƙofa 3.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane hukunci za ka yanke daga bayanin da aka sani yanzu?
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.after: Ba a san yadda mai gabatarwa ke buɗe ƙofa ba, saboda haka duka 'mu ɗauka cewa hanya iri ɗaya ce' da 'babu isasshen bayani' hukunce-hukunce ne masu ma'ana.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan ya tabbatar cewa sauya zaɓi ya fi kyau ba tare da wani bayani ba.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Sauya ko a'a, abu ɗaya ne.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ya ɗauka cewa sauran ƙofofin biyu suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan ya ɗauka cewa sauran ƙofofin biyu suna da yiwuwar iri ɗaya.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan ya ɗora fifiko ga ƙofar da aka fara zaɓa.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Babu isasshen bayani domin yanke hukunci.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan ya lura cewa ana buƙatar sanin yadda mai gabatarwa yake aiki.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabon bayani: Mai gabatarwa ya san inda motar take, kuma kullum yana buɗe ƙofar da akuya take ciki daga cikin ƙofofin da mai fafatawa bai zaɓa ba. Idan awaki suna bayan ƙofofin biyu da ba a zaɓa ba, mai gabatarwa yana buɗe ɗaya daga cikinsu bisa bazata, yiwuwarsu iri ɗaya.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu mene ne yiwuwar nasara idan ka sauya zaɓi?
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.1.after: Yiwuwar motar tana bayan ƙofa 1 tana nan 1/3, kuma yiwuwar 2/3 cewa tana bayan ƙofa 2 ko 3 tana taruwa a ƙofa 2 bayan cire ƙofar 3 da aka buɗe. Sauya zaɓi yana ba da 2/3.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Sun yi zaton yiwuwar ƙofar farko da aka zaɓa ta 1/3 za ta ci gaba da kasancewa haka.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Sun yi zaton buɗe ƙofa da mai gabatarwa ya yi yana barin yiwuwar ƙofa 1 ba ta sauyawa kuma sauran tana taruwa a ƙofa 2.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.2.info: Wata hanya dabam: Mai gabatarwa bai san inda motar take ba, ya buɗe ɗaya daga ƙofa 2 da 3 bisa bazata, kuma bisa sa'a akuya ta bayyana (da motar ce ta bayyana, da wannan yanayin bai faru ba).
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ta wannan hanyar, mene ne yiwuwar nasara idan ka sauya zaɓi?
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan ƙofa 1 ce daidai kuma aka buɗe ƙofa 3, yiwuwar ita ce 1/3×1/2=1/6; idan ƙofa 2 ce daidai kuma aka buɗe ƙofa 3, yiwuwar ita ce 1/3×1/2=1/6. Sun yi daidai. An cire yanayin motar tana bayan ƙofa 3, saboda haka ƙofofi 1 da 2 kowacce tana da 1/2.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauko sakamakon hanyar baya yadda yake ba tare da canji ba.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan ya yi la'akari da yiwuwar ƙofa 3 da aka buɗe tana da akuya, ya ga cewa ƙofofi 1 da 2 suna da nauyi iri ɗaya.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan ya ɗauka zaɓin farko ya fi kyau.
y-m-65-11.s.s1.reflect: Ka waiwayi hukuncinka na farko, sannan yadda bayanin hanyar mai gabatarwa ya sauya ko ya bar hukuncin yadda yake.
y-m-65-11.s.s2.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa yiwuwar nasara idan aka sauya zaɓi ta bambanta bisa hanyoyin biyu na mai gabatarwa (buɗewa da sani da buɗewa ba tare da sani ba).
y-m-65-11.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowace hanya, kwatanta yadda yiwuwar abin da ya faru 'an buɗe ƙofa 3 kuma akuya ta bayyana' take dogara da inda motar take.
y-m-65-11.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowace hanya, duba ko yiwuwar wannan abin ya faru tana dogara da inda motar take.
y-m-65-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ce yiwuwar buɗe ƙofa 3 tana bambanta bisa inda motar take?
y-m-65-11.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta ko zaɓin mai gabatarwa bayani ne mai amfani ko ba haka ba?
y-m-65-11.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka tabbatar ta hanyar jera yanayin da kanka?
y-m-65-11.s.s2.model.0: Idan mai gabatarwa ya san inda motar take kuma da gangan ya buɗe ƙofar akuya, hakan kusan ba ya ba da alamar ko ƙofa 1 daidai ce, saboda haka yiwuwar tana taruwa a ƙofa 2 ta zama 2/3. Idan ya buɗe bisa bazata kuma akuya ta fito bisa sa'a, yanayin da motar take ciki sun kasu gida biyu, kowanne 1/2.
y-m-65-11.s.s2.model.1: Idan mai gabatarwa ya buɗe da sani, idan mota tana bayan ƙofa 2 zai iya buɗe ƙofa 3 kawai, saboda haka yiwuwar tana karkata sau biyu; amma idan ya buɗe ba tare da sani ba, yiwuwar buɗe ƙofa 3 iri ɗaya ce ko ƙofa 1 ko 2 ce daidai, saboda haka babu sabon bayani. Wannan ne ya sa yiwuwar ta bambanta.

y-m-65-12.prereq.0: Alamar H2/H3 a wannan aiki matakin wahala ne kawai don samarwa. Ba ya nufin manhajar makaranta ta ware wannan batu ga wani aji.
y-m-65-12.title: Lokacin da tsayin jadawalin rabon iri ɗaya ya haura 1
y-m-65-12.topic: Canji bazuwar mai ci gaba: ƙimar aikin yawan yiwuwa da yiwuwar
y-m-65-12.goal: Fahimci cewa ƙimar aikin yawan yiwuwa ba ita ce yiwuwa kanta ba, sannan ka ƙirƙiri tazara da ta cika sharadin da yawan yiwuwar zai iya fi 1.
y-m-65-12.material: Canji bazuwar mai ci gaba X yana bin rabo iri ɗaya mai yawan yiwuwa tsayayye a tazara daga 0 zuwa a. Jadawali murabba'i ne mai tsayi tsayayye a wannan tazara, 0 kuma a waje. Jimillar yankin sifar 1 ce. Wani ɗalibi ya yi iƙirari: 'Idan a=0.5, yawan yiwuwa ya zama 2, amma yiwuwa ba za ta iya zama 2 ba, saboda haka babu irin wannan rabon.'
y-m-65-12.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misali da ya cika sharadin
y-m-65-12.prereq.1: Ma'anar canji bazuwar mai ci gaba da aikin yawan yiwuwa (yiwuwar tazara ita ce yankin da ke ƙarƙashin jadawali)
y-m-65-12.prereq.2: Sharadi: aikin yana magana ne kan rabo iri ɗaya wanda aikin yawan yiwuwarsa yake da ƙima tsayayye a tazara [0, a]. Ba a buƙatar lissafin integral a wannan aiki.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.prompt: Yanzu me kake tunani game da iƙirarin ɗalibin?
y-m-65-12.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo yankin murabba'i mai tsayi 2 da faɗi 0.5.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta a jadawalin mene ne 'ƙimar yawan yiwuwa' da 'yiwuwar tazara' kowannensu.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.o.a: Hujjar daidai ce. Yiwuwar ba za ta wuce 1 ba, saboda haka babu rabo mai tsayin 2.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauki ƙimar yawan yiwuwar kai tsaye a matsayin yiwuwa.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.o.b: Tazarar tana da tsawon 0.5 kawai, saboda haka ba za a iya ayyana ta a matsayin rabon yiwuwa ba.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.r.b: Sun yi tunanin tazara gajera tana hana rabon samuwa.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.o.c: Tsayin na iya wuce 1, amma sai jimillar yankin ta wuce 1, saboda haka irin wannan rabo ba ya samuwa.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.r.c: Sun yi tunanin idan tsayi ya wuce 1, yankin ma zai wuce 1. Idan faɗi gajere ne, yankin zai iya zama 1 duk da tsayi mai yawa.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.o.d: Idan jimillar yankin 1 ce, zai iya zama rabon yiwuwa ko da tsayin 2 ne.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.r.d: Sun fahimci cewa yiwuwa yanki ne, ba tsayi ba.
y-m-65-12.s.s1.explain: Yiwuwar yanki ce a kan tazara, abin da ake buƙata kawai shi ne jimillar yankin ta zama 1. Tsayi 2 ne, faɗi 0.5 ne, don haka yankin 1 ne.
y-m-65-12.s.s2.prompt: Ɗalibin ya ci gaba da hujjar kamar haka. Zaɓi layin farko da ba daidai ba.
y-m-65-12.s.s2.hint.0: Duba abin da kowace layi ke nufi da kalmar 'yiwuwa'.
y-m-65-12.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo yiwuwar tazara [0, 0.25] a matsayin yanki.

y-m-65-12.s.s2.line.3: Don haka rabon iri ɗaya mai a=0.5 ba ya samuwa.

y-m-65-12.s.s3.prompt: Ƙirƙiri ƙimomi 3 daban-daban na a inda yawan yiwuwar 1/a na rabon iri ɗaya a [0,a] ya fi 1, kuma tazara [0, 0.2] tana cikin zangon rabon.
